Brown pebbled leather ankle boots with full brogue detailing, open lacing, rounded toe, contrast striped laces, visible welt stitching and moderate wear/patina on toe areas and soles. Mark's notes: comfortable but they slow his walking pace — fine, but worth flagging on days with heavy commuting or long London walks. Alternative styling (winter only): worn hiking-boot-style with jeans tucked into thick hiking socks that are folded over the top of the boot — a deliberate fashion-hiker look.
user_notes: Slows walking pace — not a comfort issue, just slower. Consider for boards / fixed-location days; consider an alternative for heavy-walking days.
Winter alt-styling: pair with jeans + thick hiking socks folded over the boot top. Deliberate fashion-hiker look.

Chronograph with sunray blue dial, three sub-dials, date window at 3 o'clock, applied indices. Two-tone stainless steel bracelet (polished silver outer links, gold-tone centre links).

INHERITED FROM MARK'S DAD. High-value, sentimentally irreplaceable. Datejust on jubilee bracelet, fluted bezel, silver/champagne dial with stick indices, date window with cyclops. NOT a daily driver — reserve for genuine special occasions (weddings, milestone events, anniversaries, ceremonial dinners). Even sharp client meetings default to the Huawei, not this. Treat the wear count as something to keep low — both for the watch and because that's what makes wearing it mean something.
Vintage-look chronograph with cream/off-white dial, mixed numeric and stick indices, three sub-dials, date window. Brown croc-pattern leather strap. Reads more dressy than sporty.

Chronograph with deep blue dial, tachymeter bezel, three sub-dials, rose gold case and bezel detail. Tan leather strap with branded keeper loop. Statement piece — the rose gold case carries the outfit.

Multi-function watch with blue dial and blue inner bezel, three sub-dials, matte black case, '50 metres' water resistance marking. Black leather strap with blue contrast stitching. Sportier, weekend-leaning piece.
Smooth dark brown leather belt with brushed satin nickel frame buckle. Versatile — pairs with chinos, jeans, smart trousers in the brown-shoe family.

Rectangular full-rim optical frames in matte navy finish, visible Superdry branding and Japanese script detailing on inner arms. Casual / weekday-office pair — pulls warmer / more casual than the clear pair.

Rimless rectangular optical frames with bright lime green arms, black bridge and hinges, clear nose pads. Lightweight, minimalist, distinctly statement. Reads as a deliberate style moment — pair with quieter outfits (the lime IS the accent).

DEFAULT DAILY GLASSES per Mark. Transparent full-rim rectangular acetate-style optical frames with subtle silver metal arm detailing. Near-invisible — lets the face do the work. Most versatile: office, casual, date, formal — works across the full register range.

DEFAULT DAILY WATCH. Huawei smartwatch (Watch GT-style) — tracks metrics, shows messages on the wrist, adaptive. Three interchangeable leather straps (brown, tan, black) and multiple changeable digital faces, so the same watch flexes across formality bands and colour palettes. Photo shows the 'Military' analogue face on the brown strap; daily configuration varies. Wear this by default unless an outfit specifically benefits from one of the other watches (Rolex for sharp/formal, Accurist/Bersigar for leather-colour coordination, Sekonda for sporty casual).
